description: Update notification bar and Thunderbird restart functionality.

message.description: Message to display in the notification bar

functions.name: showUpdateBar
functions.description: Show update notification bar in all 3-pane windows.

functions.name: hideUpdateBar
functions.description: Hide update notification bar from all windows.

functions.name: getPendingUpdateVersion
functions.description: Return the pending TabMail add-on update version retained for this Thunderbird process.

functions.name: setPendingUpdateVersion
functions.description: Record a pending TabMail add-on update for this Thunderbird process.

functions.name: clearPendingUpdateVersion
functions.description: Clear the pending TabMail add-on update version.

functions.name: isUpdateBarVisible
functions.description: Check if update bar is currently visible in any window.

functions.name: checkForUpdates
functions.description: Manually trigger an addon update check.

events.name: onNotificationAction
events.description: Fired when user interacts with the notification bar.
